verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a documented public REST API covering text generation, streaming, reasoning control, structured outputs, image and video generation and editing, and speech-to-text, with a quickstart. Probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai/openapi.json and an llms.txt, both useful for AI-native consumers. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and evidence that consumer-app features (connectors, Grok Bot, workspace management) are exposed through the API.
